dslRule:
<!id: gc.drawText-to-drawString-transparent>
<!description: Replace GC.drawText(String, int, int) with GC.drawString(String, int, int, boolean) for transparent drawing. This typically makes text render on a transparent background, respecting underlying content.> 
<!severity: INFO>

$gc.drawText($string, $x, $y)
=> $gc.drawString($string, $x, $y, true)
;;
summary: Replaces GC.drawText(String, int, int) with GC.drawString(String, int, int, true) for transparent text rendering.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
